facts.fact: The Commune of Ouagadougou launched street addressing (marking of street names and door numbers) in arrondissements 5 and 12 on 2 April 2025, covering over 2,277 streets and 43,000 doors, following arrondissements 1 and 2, with European Union support, according to the head of the city's special delegation.

facts.fact: Sidwaya reports the EU-funded PASIU pilot (EUR 1 million) updated addressing in three Ouagadougou arrondissements and Bobo-Dioulasso, with over 93,000 doors and 16,000 streets addressed in Ouagadougou and two digital address platforms, Easy Geo and Webmapping grand Ouaga data, built.
